scripts.install: npm install --prefix ./ package.json && npm install --prefix ./autofeedback-webapp package.json && npm install --prefix ./autofeedback-server package.json
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix ./autofeedback-webapp && npm run prepare-backend
scripts.prepare-backend: shx mkdir -p ./autofeedback-server/dist/webapp && shx cp -r ./autofeedback-webapp/build/* autofeedback-server/dist/webapp && npm run build --prefix ./autofeedback-server
